answer:
Calculate the free thermal-mismatch strain in the aluminum film using the formula ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
Use the aluminum film coefficient of thermal expansion α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the ceramic substrate coefficient of thermal expansion α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the cooling temperature change ΔT = 180 K.
The result is ε = (23 − 8)×10⁻⁶ × 180 = 2.7×10⁻³ (i.e., 2700 µε, tensile in the film upon cooling).
State the final answer as a strain value with appropriate units and note that it is tensile because the film has a higher CTE than the substrate and the system is cooled.
